claims: The 98th Academy Awards are scheduled to take place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards honors films released in 2025.
The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences notes that the 98th Academy Awards will be held at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles.
Conan O'Brien is hosting the 98th Academy Awards ceremony.
The ABC Network is the broadcaster for the 98th Academy Awards.
According to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, the official Academy key dates indicate preliminary voting occurs in December 2025.
According to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, the official Academy key dates indicate final nominations are announced early in 2026.
